config_summary: m02 frozen; grammar/band tokenizer plus zero-start token texton carrier, conservative strength

adjustment: reject as mainline; carrier source/routing, not amplitude, is the bottleneck

config_summary: m02 frozen; same carrier with stronger HP-SWD and high branch
freeze_policy: freeze m02 backbone/style_emb/style_spatial; train grammar+band vocab plus token_texton_carrier_mapper only

verified_claim: stronger carrier recovers Hayao slightly but still below ag02 globally
adjustment: reject simple texton-residual route; next carrier must be style-routed/prototype-based

config_summary: m02 frozen; grammar/band tokenizer plus zero-start prototype carrier sourced from style-routed style_feat
freeze_policy: freeze m02 backbone/style_emb/style_spatial; train grammar+band vocab plus token_prototype_carrier_mapper only
purpose: test whether missing style energy is a source/routing problem rather than residual amplitude
verified_claim: prototype carrier has nonzero energy and safe grids, but does not beat ag02 or solve Hayao
adjustment: reject amplitude/source-from-style_feat route; next source must be explicit target-style memory/prototype bank

config_summary: m02 frozen; same prototype carrier with stronger high-band allocation and lower anchor
freeze_policy: freeze m02 backbone/style_emb/style_spatial; train grammar+band vocab plus token_prototype_carrier_mapper only
purpose: stress-test whether prototype source can move toward clip_style above 0.72 while LPIPS remains below 0.50
verified_claim: stronger prototype carrier has more carrier RMS but worse aggregate style/LPIPS
adjustment: stop strengthening this branch; build data-derived style memory source instead

config_summary: m02 adapter with style_spatial_id_16 blended 25% toward training-set body-feature mean prototypes
freeze_policy: freeze backbone/style_emb/tokenizer; edit only style_spatial_id_16 adapter source
purpose: test whether m02's style source is under-representing target style manifold
verified_claim: mean body prototype is safe but slightly below m02/ag02; averaged training-set source is too smooth
adjustment: do not use single mean source; if memory is revisited it needs multi-prototype/token selection

config_summary: m02 adapter with style_spatial_id_16 blended 35% toward high-texture body-feature exemplar prototypes
freeze_policy: freeze backbone/style_emb/tokenizer; edit only style_spatial_id_16 adapter source
purpose: test whether mean prototypes are too smooth and a texture atlas source is needed
verified_claim: high-texture exemplar slightly lifts Hayao but hurts LPIPS and does not raise global style
adjustment: single style_spatial replacement is not enough; next memory design must be token-selected multi-prototype, not one blended map

config_summary: m02 adapter frozen; generation uses one random internal target-style latent as target_style_latent reference source
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_adapter/tokenizer; no training and no loss change
purpose: test whether explicit internal style source breaks the id-only m02/tokenizer plateau
verified_claim: internal reference source raises global style by +0.00440 vs m02 and Hayao by +0.02238, proving source quality is a bottleneck
adjustment: build token-selected multi-prototype source; do not promote exemplar-guided inference as final id-only protocol

config_summary: m02 adapter frozen; target reference chosen from high-texture candidates by source low-frequency match
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_adapter/tokenizer; no training and no loss change
purpose: test whether content-compatible reference selection improves the reference-memory gain
verified_claim: low-frequency matching is only +0.00032 clip over random and slightly lower on Hayao; source existence matters more than this selector
adjustment: next route should learn local/token-selected multi-prototype routing rather than hand-pick one global reference

config_summary: m02 frozen; adapter-side id-only style_memory_bank_16 uses 4 high-texture body-feature prototypes per style with blend=0.65
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_emb/tokenizer; no loss change; build adapter source bank only
purpose: test whether explicit internal prototype sources can recover reference-memory style lift without test-time reference
verified_claim: high-texture multi-prototype bank loads and is safe but stays below ag02; static style-id mixture collapses back to m02 plateau
adjustment: reject static bank; next source must be local/content-conditioned rather than one global style-id mixture

config_summary: m02 frozen; adapter-side id-only style_memory_bank_16 uses 4 low-frequency diverse body-feature prototypes per style with blend=0.65
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_emb/tokenizer; no loss change; build adapter source bank only
purpose: test whether prototype diversity fixes centroid smoothing in id-only memory source
verified_claim: diverse prototypes also remain on the m02 plateau; image-level/static diversity is not enough
adjustment: reject global diverse mixture; routing must be spatially adaptive

config_summary: m02 frozen; high-texture k4 bank with highpass_boost=1.12 and blend=0.75
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_emb/tokenizer; no loss change; strengthen adapter source bank only
purpose: stress-test whether stronger prototype texture can approach the rm01 diagnostic lift
verified_claim: stronger texture/blend does not raise style and slightly weakens Hayao; the bottleneck is routing not source amplitude
adjustment: stop static-bank amplitude pushes; move prototype selection into local actuator/routing path

config_summary: m02 frozen; high-texture prototype bank selected by local content-token attention before style-map actuator, route_strength=0.45
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_emb/tokenizer; no loss change; route source bank locally at inference
purpose: test whether content-conditioned local prototype routing recovers reference-memory style without test-time reference
verified_claim: local token attention changes outputs but remains below ag02; inserting routing before the frozen style-map actuator is insufficient
adjustment: reject route-only adapter; router must enter a trainable actuator or be present during backbone training

config_summary: m02 frozen; high-texture prototype bank selected by local content-token attention before style-map actuator, route_strength=0.65
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/style_emb/tokenizer; no loss change; route source bank locally at inference
purpose: stress-test whether stronger local routing can lift clip_style while LPIPS stays below 0.50
verified_claim: stronger local route still remains below ag02 and weakens Hayao; temperature/strength sweeps are not justified
adjustment: stop route-only adapter branch; train a router-aware actuator/backbone instead of sweeping route amplitude

config_summary: fixed br00 local router source; train body/blender/decoder/output_head for 2 epochs from m02 epoch6
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train actuator/backbone consumer only
purpose: test whether the frozen route-only failure is due to actuator not learning the routed source
verified_claim: training the old style-map interface raises Hayao but drops global style and worsens LPIPS; the interface is still too entangled
adjustment: do not continue route-strength sweeps; prototype source needs a separate constrained field, not just trained consumption of the old map

config_summary: high-texture K4 prototype bank; route_strength=0; residual source = routed_memory - base_map; residual_strength=0.22; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: test whether prototype source works when it bypasses the collapsed style-map interface as a body residual
verified_claim: residual source is numerically active and non-hazy, but global style falls far below ag02; untyped memory residual behaves like average perturbation
adjustment: reject unconstrained residual injection; next source must be style-field typed or OT-aligned before entering the backbone

config_summary: high-texture K4 prototype bank; residual source highpass kernel 5 + support gate gamma 4; residual_strength=0.32; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: test whether highpass-gated prototype residual can add texton energy without color fog
verified_claim: highpass residual is cleaner than rs00 on LPIPS but still lowers style; simply injecting texton energy is not a valid tokenizer representation
adjustment: reject residual-strength/highpass sweeps; route must be supervised by style-field semantics or a contrastive prototype assignment

config_summary: typed flat/edge/texton prototype bank; content-nearest routing; residual_strength=0.18; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: test whether explicit flat/edge/texton memory roles fix untyped residual collapse
verified_claim: typed gates are finite and active, but global style still drops below ag02; content-local typing alone is insufficient
adjustment: reject typed/content-nearest residual as promotion; prototype assignment must be style-measure aligned before dynamics

config_summary: typed flat/edge/texton prototype bank; highpass support; residual_strength=0.24; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: test whether highpass support makes typed residual add texture without content drift
verified_claim: highpass typed residual is finite but loses more style than rt00 while only slightly improving LPIPS
adjustment: reject highpass/strength sweep for typed residual; missing constraint is style-discriminative assignment

config_summary: typed bank with uniform within-type routing; residual_strength=0.20; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: test whether content-nearest selection inside each type caused style dilution
verified_claim: uniform within type improves LPIPS relative to rt00 but remains well below ag02 on style
adjustment: reject uniform typing; style atoms need OT/contrastive target-style selection, not type averaging

config_summary: typed bank with uniform within-type routing plus highpass support; residual_strength=0.24; train actuator 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head
purpose: stress-test typed uniform highpass route after rt02
verified_claim: best typed variant is still below ag02 and below the diagnostic reference; typing is active but not style-aligned
adjustment: stop typed residual variants; next route must optimize prototype assignment against target style measure before injection

config_summary: adapter-only Fisher style projection; 6 prototypes per style; residual source strength 0.20
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/backbone/tokenizer; build adapter source bank only
purpose: test whether raw style descriptor inseparability caused style-average prototype selection
verified_claim: Fisher projection makes prototype purity separable: abs_mean 1.063 vs raw ma00 0.0015
adjustment: promote only to consumer test; not a scored generation result

config_summary: adapter-only Fisher style projection plus flat/edge/texton roles; 9 prototypes per style; residual strength 0.22
freeze_policy: freeze checkpoint/backbone/tokenizer; build typed adapter source bank only
purpose: test whether typed atoms become style-discriminative after Fisher projection
verified_claim: Fisher projection makes typed prototype purity separable: abs_mean 0.913 vs raw ma01 0.0043
adjustment: promote only to consumer test; not a scored generation result

config_summary: fixed mf00 Fisher-selected source; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train actuator/backbone consumer only
purpose: test whether separable style atoms recover reference-memory lift when consumed by the current residual actuator
verified_claim: Fisher selection is separable but the current residual actuator consumes it as non-style perturbation; below ag02
adjustment: reject residual-bank consumption; next route needs operator-bound style source or tokenizer-to-operator binding

config_summary: fixed mf01 typed Fisher source; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb/style_spatial_id_16/style_tokenizer; train actuator/backbone consumer only
purpose: test whether typed roles plus Fisher style projection fix typed residual collapse
verified_claim: typed Fisher atoms are separable but still lower global style than ag02 and rt00
adjustment: stop residual-bank variants; bind style coordinates directly to executable operators before full eval

config_summary: no training; Fisher axes aligned to measured mid/high energy and written into band[0:3], grammar[1,5,6,7]
freeze_policy: freeze m02 checkpoint and m02 style adapter; no optimizer; main OMF loss unchanged
purpose: test whether discriminative Fisher coordinates become executable when bound directly to transport-AdaIN tokenizer fields
verified_claim: preview endpoint_rms=0.01036, detail_over_low=1.160, high_fraction=0.430; grammar_mid perturb active endpoint_rms=0.00222
adjustment: promote to tokenizer-only training; continue to reject residual-bank consumption

config_summary: Fisher-token initialized grammar/band fields; train only tokenizer for 80 iters per target style; SWD+HP-SWD with m02 anchor
freeze_policy: freeze m02 backbone, style_emb, style_spatial_id_16, decoder and all non-tokenizer params; train grammar_vocab and band_vocab only
purpose: test whether executable Fisher-bound tokenizer fields can raise style without fog or residual-bank drift
verified_claim: training stayed visually safe but style fell below ag02=0.710955 and token values barely moved; SWD gradient is too indirect for these scalar gates
adjustment: do not continue scalar-gate SWD sweeps; next route needs a stronger executable operator such as depthwise kernel or direct style-measure target for tokenizer

config_summary: no training; grammar[8:15] controls fixed 3x3 depthwise filter bank on transport-AdaIN detail residual
freeze_policy: freeze m02 checkpoint and m02 style adapter; no optimizer; main OMF loss unchanged
purpose: test whether grammar-bound spatial filters provide a higher-capacity executable style operator than scalar gates
verified_claim: preview endpoint_rms=0.01087, detail_over_low=1.261, high_fraction=0.432; filter perturbations are detail-dominant but small
adjustment: promote to tokenizer-only training; if metrics remain flat, switch to backbone/actuator consumer training

config_summary: Fisher-token init plus grammar[8:15] fixed depthwise filter bank; train only tokenizer for 80 iters per target style
freeze_policy: freeze m02 backbone, style_emb, style_spatial_id_16, decoder and all non-tokenizer params; train grammar_vocab and band_vocab only
purpose: test whether higher-capacity grammar-bound spatial filters can break the m02/ag02 style plateau
verified_claim: depthwise filter delta is active (Hayao dw about 0.024) and grid is safe, but metrics are unchanged vs fo01 and below ag02
adjustment: stop tokenizer-only operator tuning here; next spiral step is freeze tokenizer and train the backbone/actuator to consume this operator

config_summary: resume fo11 checkpoint; frozen Fisher/depthwise tokenizer; train body/blender/skip_fusion/decoder/output_head for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb, style_spatial_id_16, style_tokenizer; train actuator/backbone consumer only
purpose: test whether the frozen-m02 bottleneck is consumer learning rather than tokenizer expressivity
verified_claim: Full consumer-path training moves Hayao slightly but lowers global style and worsens LPIPS versus ag02; the trainable set is too broad and consumes the operator as repaint/drift.
adjustment: reject broad consumer-only route; next test should train a narrow operator interface such as blender-only or add a tiny zero-init operator gate

config_summary: resume fo11 checkpoint; frozen Fisher/depthwise tokenizer; train only StyleBlender for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style_emb, style_spatial_id_16, style_tokenizer, body, skip, decoder and output_head; train blender only
purpose: test whether the depthwise grammar operator can be consumed through the narrow operator interface without fo12 repaint drift
verified_claim: StyleBlender transport_adain mode does not use blender alpha/conv/mod_mapper in the active loss path; selecting only blender parameters gives a loss with no grad_fn
adjustment: replace blender-only with a real narrow interface: a learnable mid/high gate directly on the depthwise operator

config_summary: resume fo11 checkpoint; enable two-scalar learnable mid/high gate on depthwise grammar operator; train gate only for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze fo11 tokenizer, style identity, body, skip, decoder and output_head; train token_depthwise_filter_gate_logits only
purpose: test whether the active depthwise grammar operator needs a tiny actuator gain rather than broad consumer retraining
verified_claim: The gate is connected and trainable, but two scalar mid/high gains are underpowered: global style and Hayao are slightly below fo11 and ag02 while LPIPS is unchanged
adjustment: do not continue scalar gate-only; next minimal interface should be gate plus output_head or a per-style/per-basis depthwise gate

config_summary: resume fo11 checkpoint; enable learnable mid/high depthwise gate; train gate plus output_head for 2 epochs with gate LR multiplier 50x
freeze_policy: freeze fo11 tokenizer, style identity, body, skip and decoder; train token_depthwise_filter_gate_logits plus output_head only
purpose: test whether the smallest connected consumer surface can turn depthwise grammar transport into latent delta without fo12 repaint drift
verified_claim: Output_head consumption raises Hayao strongly but fails global style and worsens LPIPS; learned gate stays near identity, so output_head absorbs the operator as target-specific repaint rather than clean style geometry
adjustment: reject as mainline; next valid step is a per-style/per-basis depthwise operator gate or style-discriminative assignment, not broader output_head/body training

config_summary: resume fo11 checkpoint; add zero-init style-id x depthwise-basis gate inside grammar operator; train only that gate for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze fo11 tokenizer, style identity, body, skip, decoder and output_head; train token_depthwise_filter_style_basis_gate_logits only
purpose: test whether style-local basis allocation can move style without shared output_head repaint
verified_claim: Style-local depthwise basis gate is connected and learns nonzero per-style basis allocation without LPIPS drift, but global style and Hayao remain below ag02; fixed basis alphabet is underpowered.
adjustment: stop fixed-basis gate-only; next operator route should jointly train tokenizer grammar/band with the style-local gate or replace the fixed depthwise basis with a learned style-discriminative alphabet

config_summary: resume fo18 checkpoint; jointly train style-local depthwise basis gate plus tokenizer grammar/band fields for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style identity source and full LANCET backbone/output head; train token_depthwise_filter_style_basis_gate_logits, style_tokenizer.grammar_vocab and style_tokenizer.band_vocab only
purpose: test whether fo18 is flat because frozen fo11 tokenizer coordinates point into the wrong depthwise basis directions
verified_claim: This was too incremental after fo18; it still assumes the fixed Sobel/Laplace basis is adequate.
adjustment: replace with fo20, which learns the style-local high-pass operator alphabet itself while keeping backbone/output head frozen

config_summary: resume fo18 checkpoint; learn style-local zero-mean high-pass depthwise basis deltas plus tokenizer grammar/band assignment for 2 epochs
freeze_policy: freeze style identity source and full LANCET backbone/output head; train token_depthwise_filter_style_basis_delta, token_depthwise_filter_style_basis_gate_logits, style_tokenizer.grammar_vocab and style_tokenizer.band_vocab
purpose: test whether the bottleneck is the fixed depthwise operator alphabet rather than tokenizer assignment or output-head consumption
verified_claim: fo18 showed style-local gate is connected but fixed bases are underpowered; fo17 showed output_head repaint is a trap, so learn the operator alphabet under high-pass constraints
adjustment: started full remote run after deleting two-batch smoke output; promote if global style beats ag02 or Hayao rises without LPIPS drift
